model: UNOlite indoor air quality monitor (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Delta UNOlite indoor air quality monitors (including the LWD model) with DIP switch 7 set to BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The UNOlite is a room air quality monitor with an RS-485 port that runs Modbus or BACnet MS/TP (DIP switch 7 ON). Over BACnet it reports temperature, humidity, PM1/PM2.5/PM10, CO2, TVOC, an IAQ index and the RESET viral index (RVI), and has writable values for MAC address, sensor calibration, CO2 self-calibration, display and IAQ LED thresholds.
default_device_instance: From the serial number (e.g. SN 2301L0170040 gives 010040)
notes: The object table has no access column; AVs are marked writable from their descriptions except AV 11/AV 12, which the guide describes as outputs to another controller.
AV 4 Auto-Dim applies to the LWD model only.
A sensor object's Out_Of_Service = true means that sensor is unhealthy; power cycle to recover.
Units for AV 11, AV 12 and the IAQ thresholds are not printed.
Different object set and numbering from the UNOnext and UNOslim (e.g. AI 4 is PM1 here, CO2 on UNOnext).

integration.summary: Set DIP 7 ON for BACnet, DIP 1-4 for the MAC address (0-15) and DIP 5-6 for the baud rate, then read the measurements. Use AV 0 for MAC addresses above 15.
setup: DIP 7 ON = BACnet MS/TP, OFF = Modbus. DIP 8 = 120 ohm terminator. Set DIPs with power off.
DIP 1-4 set MAC 0-15; DIP 5-6 set baud: both OFF 76800, then 9600, 19200, 38400.
AV 0 sets any MAC 0-127 and overrides the DIPs; the device reboots after the write.
Device instance comes from the serial number and is writable; factory reset restores it. Max_Master 127.
gotchas: Writing AV 2 CO2_Cali turns off CO2 self-calibration (AV 3 goes to 0).

points.name: IAQ
points.description: Air quality index from PM and CO2 (drives IAQ LED)

points.name: RVI
points.description: Viral infection risk index, 0-99 (higher is better)

points.name: MAC Address
points.description: MS/TP MAC 0-127; overrides DIP; 255 clears; reboots

points.name: Temperature_Cali
points.description: Write actual temperature x100 to calibrate

points.name: CO2_Cali
points.description: Write actual CO2 (400-1500) to calibrate; disables ASC

points.name: RESET_TVOC
points.description: Write 1 to reset the TVOC baseline

points.name: TVOC_Cali
points.description: TVOC reference 1-500 ppb for calibration; 9999 resets
